dataset_spec.name: wids2021
dataset_spec.description: WiDS Datathon 2021 diabetes mellitus task (5000 ICU encounters after restricted predictor set and stratified subsample).
dataset_spec.setting: ICU admission: predicting whether the patient has a pre-existing diagnosis of diabetes mellitus from demographics, acuity, and non-glucose laboratory/comorbidity features.
dataset_spec.observations_header: ICU admission demographics, acuity and comorbidities:

diabetes_mellitus.question: Based on the ICU admission demographics, acuity and comorbidity features (excluding glucose measurements), does the patient have diabetes mellitus?
